sampler.distribution: Each element is an equal-weight (1:1) oneof of (a) a short interval (start in [-50, 50], length 0..5) and (b) a full-range interval (two ordered integers in [-1000, 1000]). array length 0..32 via fast-check biased integer sizing (size: "max"). Shrinking re-applies the ordering, so it stays valid.

contractVerdictGuide: Leave contractVerdict null until you adjudicate by hand. A returned-value discrepancy is not a confirmed candidate violation. Suggested values: candidate-violation, reference-bug, ambiguous-contract, not-a-violation.

incompleteSides.message: No result within 2000 ms (stopped at stage "loading").

reference.message: No result within 2000 ms (stopped at stage "loading").

candidate.note: value is the JSON form of the result. Extra own properties are listed in observations and were captured before serialization.

interruption.note: This run did not complete on the input above. It is not a value discrepancy and was not shrunk. A reference-side failure, or a candidate failure at stage "startup" or "loading", is an infrastructure problem. A candidate timeout at stage "call" is the only shape that may be genuine candidate nontermination; confirm it by replaying this input. Replay does not call Ollama or change the candidate.

replay.note: Replay runs the saved candidate again. It does not call Ollama and it does not change the candidate file.
